segments.name: Steelmaking
segments.description: Vertically integrated steel producer serving automotive, infrastructure and manufacturing, distributors, converters and steel producers in North America.
segments.evidence: We primarily operate through one reportable segment – the Steelmaking segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers in North America pay for steel products under fixed-price contracts, spot market sales, or contracts with variable pricing tied to a published steel index.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell approximately 35-40% of our flat-rolled steel shipments under fixed price contracts.

changes.text: In 2024, the company completed the Stelco Acquisition, expanding its presence in Canada.
changes.evidence: On November 1, 2024, we completed the Stelco Acquisition.

changes.text: In 2025, the company decided to fully or partially idle, or permanently close, six operations including permanently closing its Steelton, Conshohocken and Riverdale facilities.
changes.evidence: During 2025, we made the decision to fully or partially idle, or permanently close, six of our operations.
